title: obs.frame / cmd.frame params (inline binding, AWP-DAT-004)
description: The frame header and extension fields as JSON, payload base64-encoded.

flags.description: Bit 0 keyframe, bit 1 end-of-burst, bit 3 resync. Senders set bits 2 and 4-7 to 0 (extensions are explicit fields in JSON) and never set resync without keyframe (AWP-DAT-004/005/009); receivers ignore bits 4-7.

ts_send_ns.description: Required on observation frames in streaming sessions (AWP-OBS-006).
